review:
Looking at the ArticlesApi.java file provided, I can see that it uses `NewArticleParam` as a request DTO, which is imported from `io.spring.application.article.NewArticleParam`.

Here is the violation:

- `NewArticleParam` is declared in a separate file (`io.spring.application.article`) instead of being declared at the bottom of the ArticlesApi.java file, violating the rule: "A request DTO for a REST endpoint is a package-private class declared at the bottom of the controller file it belongs to... never in its own file."
